description: Investment advisers from the SEC's Form ADV database (IAPD) by name or CRD: matching firms with SEC file numbers, status, whether they report disclosure events, offices and branch counts, then the best match in full: registration and since when, other names and relying advisers, its latest ADV date, and links to its Form ADV and brochures.

limit.description: Most matching firms to list for a name; default 10.

query.description: A firm's name ("Bridgewater Associates", "Renaissance Technologies") or its CRD number (105129).

name: investment_advisers

outputSchema.description: rows are matching firms in the order of columns; firm is the best match (or the CRD asked for) in full.

title: Investment advisers (Form ADV)
